Kandy Kush blends the iconic OG Kush with the lively edge of Trainwreck to create a hybrid that’s both soothing and uplifting. Its relaxing body high eases tension and can curb anxiety, all while keeping you present enough for easy conversation, casual gatherings, or a mellow creative session.
